snippet.title: Myth Twice Born Edition Trailer
snippet.description:
Project Magma proudly presents - Myth: Twice Born Edition
This is a full-on remaster of Myth: The Fallen Lords (through its ports to Myth II: Soulblighter), Myth II: Soulblighter, and Myth II: Chimera. Some of the HD assets will also cover third-party plugins, but they will not be as uniform as the rest.

Links:
Myth Twice Born: https://tain.totalcodex.net/items/show/myth-twice-born-edition
Latest Patch: https://projectmagma.net/
Project Magma’s The Fallen Lords: https://tain.totalcodex.net/items/show/project-magmas-the-fallen-lords
Myth TFL Deluxe: https://tain.totalcodex.net/items/show/myth-the-fallen-lords-deluxe
Bagrada Discord - https://discord.gg/dRzeEUD6eX

Please promote Myth by dreamlisting on GOG:
TFL - https://www.gog.com/dreamlist/game/myth-the-fallen-lords
Soulblighter: https://www.gog.com/dreamlist/game/myth-ii-soulblighter

Special Thanks to:
Jon God (spent a lifetime creating HD sprites)
Project Magma (keeping the patches coming)
Mark R. Bernal (creating the game and for the Twice Born box art) - https://www.instagram.com/markbernalartist/
Atlyx (soundtrack) - https://www.youtube.com/@AtlyxMusic
Myth community for keeping Myth alive
Bungie developers who created Myth, Myth 2, and Chimera
Jeoku (video editing)
And, of course, all of you watching this trailer!
